address: rue du Marché aux Porcs 11, Brussels, 1000, Belgium
bio: This always-bustling establishment near the fish market is a hub of authentic Greek hospitality and generosity. Whether you come as a couple or a large group, everyone gets the attention they deserve. The menu features a whole host of delicious mezze to choose from. Tamara with sourdough bread, tender octopus with fava beans, a salad of green lentils with smoked herring, orange and sultanas… This authentic food is packed with vibrant, honest flavours that hit the spot every time. The wine list features an impressive range of Greek options that won't break the bank....
